items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 1:13 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Meeting Video / Livestream
notes: NOTE: Due to technical difficulties, there is no video recording for the Special Council meeting this date.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 1:15 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider four matters, two land disposition and solicitor client privilege matters, one land acquistion and instruction for negotiation matter, one land acquisition and disposition matter as authorized by Sections 239 (c) (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
